description: This file contains implementation code for interacting with device graphics hardware, specifically for retrieving memory info and display size information, using Linux system interfaces and DRM (Direct Rendering Manager) APIs.

methods.name: parseLine
methods.description: Parses a line of text to extract a numeric value, used for reading memory info.

methods.name: getMemInfo
methods.description: Reads system memory info from /proc/meminfo for a given parameter.

methods.name: getPrimaryPlane
methods.description: Retrieves the primary plane ID and associated buffer from DRM device.

methods.name: getGraphicSize
methods.description: Obtains the current graphics output resolution (width and height) through DRM/KMS APIs.

methods.name: SoC_GetTotalGpuRam
methods.description: Returns total GPU RAM available in the system, retrieved from /proc/meminfo.

methods.name: SoC_GetFreeGpuRam
methods.description: Returns free GPU RAM in the system.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsWidth
methods.description: Gets the current width of the display's graphics output.

methods.name: SoC_GetGraphicsHeight
methods.description: Gets the current height of the display's graphics output.
